tools.name: calculate_pregnancy_dates
tools.description: Calculate pregnancy dates from the last menstrual period. Use ISO dates in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-04-15 and 2026-08-01.

last_menstrual_period.description: First day of the last menstrual period in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-04-15.
last_menstrual_period.title: Last Menstrual Period

as_of_date.description: Date used for the calculation in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-08-01.
as_of_date.title: As Of Date

cycle_length_days.description: Usual cycle length in days, if known; use an integer from 21 through 45.
cycle_length_days.title: Cycle Length Days

tools.name: get_immunization_status
tools.description: Check a child's status against the bundled Nigerian routine immunization schedule. Use ISO dates in YYYY-MM-DD format and exact vaccine labels such as BCG or OPV 0.

ImmunizationRecord.description: Represent one recorded child vaccine or immunization supplement.

vaccine.description: Vaccine or supplement label from the provided history, such as BCG or OPV 0.
vaccine.title: Vaccine

administered_on.description: Administration date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-01-15.
administered_on.title: Administered On

ImmunizationRecord.title: ImmunizationRecord

parameters.description: Arguments for checking the bundled Nigerian routine schedule.

child_date_of_birth.description: Child's date of birth in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-01-15.
child_date_of_birth.title: Child Date Of Birth

as_of_date.description: Date used for the schedule check in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-04-01.
as_of_date.title: As Of Date

vaccination_history.description: Known vaccine or supplement entries; use the exact supplied vaccine label and ISO administration date.
vaccination_history.title: Vaccination History

parameters.title: ImmunizationStatusArguments

tools.name: save_health_record
tools.description: Save user-provided structured health information locally. Use exactly one canonical record_type value and an ISO-8601 recorded_at timestamp, for example 2026-08-04T10:00:00.

parameters.description: Arguments for storing a user-provided health record.

record_type.description: Canonical record category; use one of pregnancy, postpartum, newborn, immunization, measurement or other.
record_type.title: Record Type

recorded_at.description: Timestamp for the supplied record in ISO-8601 format, for example 2026-08-04T10:00:00.
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

record.description: Object containing only the user-provided record fields; for example {"blood_pressure": "128/82", "gestational_weeks": 24}.
record.title: Record

parameters.title: SaveHealthRecordArguments

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a local reminder for a care or follow-up event. Use exactly one canonical category value and an ISO-8601 due_at timestamp, for example 2026-08-18T09:00:00.

parameters.description: Arguments for storing one local reminder.

title.description: Short reminder title describing the requested care action.
title.title: Title

due_at.description: Reminder time in ISO-8601 format, for example 2026-08-18T09:00:00.
due_at.title: Due At

category.description: Canonical reminder category; choose the category that matches the requested action.
category.title: Category

recurrence.description: Optional recurrence instruction; leave null for a one-time reminder.
recurrence.title: Recurrence

parameters.title: CreateReminderArguments

tools.name: convert_measurement
tools.description: Convert a measurement between supported units without clinical interpretation. Pass a numeric value without a unit suffix and use only the listed measurement types and units, for example 70.0 from in to cm.

parameters.description: Arguments for a safe unit conversion.

value.description: Numeric measurement value, without a unit suffix.
value.title: Value

measurement_type.description: Measurement kind: temperature, weight, length or volume.
measurement_type.title: Measurement Type

from_unit.description: Source unit; use one of celsius, fahrenheit, kg, lb, in, cm, l or ml.
from_unit.title: From Unit

to_unit.description: Target unit; use one of celsius, fahrenheit, kg, lb, in, cm, l or ml.
to_unit.title: To Unit

parameters.title: ConvertMeasurementArguments
